Seeding Conditions - Seed shall not be applied when the wind speed exceeds ten miles per hour unless permission is given by the COR in writing. It may also be desired by the Government that the ground be covered by a minimum of two inches of snow during seeding operations. Therefore, seeding may be delayed if there is no snow on the ground and snow is expected in the weather forecast. 3.
